title: GlowOrigins
description: A datapack that adds various origins to the Origins mod.
body:
This mod adds various origins for the Fabric mod called Origins.\
Xolotl:\
\+ Lives in water like Merlings.\
\+ Can survive without water for longer.\
\- Not as adapted to water as Merlings.\
\- Weak arms.\
\- Fragile.\
\
Cave Dweller:\
\+ Can climb and crawl.\
\+ Can see in dark.\
\- Can only sleep underground.\
\- Can only eat meat.\
\- Agoraphobic.\
\
Centaur?:\
\+ Free saddle.\
\+ Can buff self and mount when riding.\
\- Crippled.\
\
Ghost:\
\+ Can phase through blocks.\
\+ Can float.\
\+ Gains hunger from hurting others.\
\- Constantly starving.\
\- Cannot eat food.\
\
Illman:\
\+ Evoker fang and summon spells.\
\+ Illusioner invisibility and blindness spells.\
\+ Can steal from villagers.\
\- Refuses to trade with villagers.\
\- Hates blue.\
\
Imp:\
Is an imp\
Can hop through time and space\
Less nourished by physical food\
\
Nimbus:\
\+ Can swim through air.\
\+ Can push foes with wind.\
\- Extremely cluastrophobic.\
\- Can only wear light armor.\
\- Cannot use shields.\
\- Fragile.\
\- Weak arms.\
\- Sleeps at high altitudes.\
\
Ninji:\
\+ Natural swift sneak.\
\+ Bonus back stab damage.\
\+ Invisible when sneaking or in dark places.\
\+ Can use substitution jutsu.\
\- Can only wear light armor.\
\- Cannot use shields.\
\- Fragile.\
\
Sylph:\
\+ Extremely fast traveler.\
\+ Can choose to float.\
\+ Has double jump.\
\+ Bonus melee damage when sprint jumping.\
\+ Sylphid Dance.\
\- Slow when floating.\
\- Claustrophobic.\
\- Fragile.\
\- Can only wear light armor.\
\- Cannot use shields.\
\- Fragile.\
\- Weak arms.\
\- Sleeps at high altitudes.\
\- Deals less melee damage normally.
